message.reasoning_content:
The vulnerability is a heap-use-after-free in libxml2's encoding cleanup: `xmlCharEncCloseFunc` (encoding.c) is invoked on an encoding handler that has already been freed during HTML output processing (`htmlSaveFileFormat` in HTMLtree.c / `xmlOutputBufferClose` in xmlIO.c).
